name: Differential State Obfuscation
description: Replaces the clamped "battery" and "accumulated cost" variables with two abstract trackers that cross-update via a max operation. This perfectly computes the exact same final metric (mathematically equivalent to a 2-machine flow shop makespan) but eliminates the "allocated energy" affordance, preventing models from using the shortcut of maximizing covered requirements. Models must now genuinely perform an algebraic adjacent exchange to discover the optimal sorting rule.
